selection_rule: Intraday book: 3 Nifty 50 names with high rupee-volume and 20-day |momentum|, plus Nifty 50 and Bank Nifty. Swing on a wider universe is later — this file is what we trade now.
pick_method: Among largest Nifty 50 names: rank by 20-day average rupee volume times |20-day return|. HDFCBANK = liquidity. BAJFINANCE and M&M = volume with actual momentum.
